note:
R92 - diagnostic decode of `.ast` streams located by R89 and framed by R91: EALayer3 v1 (PS3) granules rebuilt into standard MPEG
frames (R77 `rebuild`, bit reservoir used the standard way) and decoded by ffmpeg `mp3float`; EA-XMA (X360) packets padded to 0x800 and
decoded by ffmpeg `xma2` through a RIFF XMA2 wrapper (R84). Decoder acceptance only - nothing here is audible correctness or a game
trace; no encoder; no replacement.

Checks, independent of the framing parser's own pass / fail:
  D1 decoded sample count == granules x 576 per de-interleaved sub-stream (EAL3) / == num_samples (XMA: the count is bitstream-driven,
     R84's header control repeated on one vector here);
  D2 decoded - 1152 - terminal trim == num_samples (EAL3; the 47-sample PCM block frame of block 0 is NOT mixed in - stated);
  D3 block -> sample map: a RESTART decode from block k (k = middle block) converges to the full decode at the offset the block map
     predicts (Σ decodable of blocks < k): rms of (restart - full) per granule, expected large on granule 0 (MDCT overlap / filter
     state absent) and ~0 afterwards - a state-continuity measurement and an independent test of the per-block sample words;
  D4 loops: stub and body decoded separately; loop start = stub samples (word a); the listening copy plays stub + body + body;
  D5 interleaved (cc 3): frames de-interleaved i % 2 -> two stereo sub-streams (rule inferred from frame order + the gi alternation
     measured by R91; NOT validated by any reference) - each decoded, counts checked; a 4-channel preview is written as two stereo files.
Outputs (local only, never under docs/): <previews>/<label>__raw.wav = the decoder's full output untouched (warm-up and tail
included, no gain change); <label>__trimmed.wav = delay 1152 (EAL3) / none (XMA) and the terminal trim applied -> exactly num_samples
(a transformation, recorded as such); loops: <label>__loop_x2.wav. Limits: one ffmpeg process at a time, 180 s timeout each, streams
above MAX_SAMPLES skipped by name.
Usage: python r92_ast_decode.py <out.json> --previews DIR [--set builtin|all-smoke] [--keep-mp3]
